title: Just what I needed
text: Just what I needed. Perfect and fits great on my bathtub and definitely helps tons since my bathtub tends to be quite slippery so this was definitely a life saver.

product_metadata.title: TIKE SMART Large Non-Slip Bathtub & Shower Mat 31"x16" (Smooth/Non-Textured Tubs Only) Safe, Clean, Machine-Washable, Superior Grip&Drainage, Vinyl, Transparent Light Brown,Medium
features: FOR SMOOTH TUB/SHOWER FLOORS ONLY - NOT FOR TEXTURED SURFACES. Safety first: The best slip-resistant bathtub mat - will keep you, your children, the elderly and disabled safe when bathing and showering. 167 powerful suction cups - will not slip when used on non-textured shower or tub surface. 31”x16", fits standard tubs or shower stalls up to 31” (we recommend measuring your shower to confirm fit), for added anti-slip protection from slip and fall accidents. Textured surface - superior grip.
CLEAN: The cleanest bathtub mat available, machine washable for years of safe, healthy, worry-free use. 144 drainage holes keep water flowing through the bath mat.

BEST MATERIALS: Highest quality phthalate-free, BPA-free allergen-free vinyl. Heavy duty, weighing in at 1.43 lbs., it lays flat and won’t slip on the tub or shower floor. Curl-free packaging makes this bath mat easy to use starting day 1. Stronger than rubber bathtub mats, cleaner than bath rugs, best of the non-slip bath mats on the market!

COMFORT: Cushioned and comfortable, like a massage for your feet. You, your kids, your parents and the elderly or disabled will feel not only safe but revitalized while bathing or showering with the most comfortable bathtub mat there is!
GUARANTEED: We back our products 100% for life, and you are free to return this product at any time with no questions asked!
